param.documentation: Wave length in SITL

param.documentation: Wave amplitude in SITL

param.documentation: Direction wave is coming from

param.name: SIM_WAVE_SPEED
param.documentation: Wave speed in SITL

param.name: SIM_TIDE_DIR
param.documentation: Tide direction wave is coming from

param.name: SIM_TIDE_SPEED
param.documentation: Tide speed in simulation

param.name: SIM_THML_SCENARI

param.name: SCHED_DEBUG
param.documentation: Set to non-zero to enable scheduler debug messages. When set to show "Slips" the scheduler will display a message whenever a scheduled task is delayed due to too much CPU load. When set to ShowOverruns the scheduled will display a message whenever a task takes longer than the limit promised in the task table.

param.name: EK3_LOG_LEVEL
param.documentation: Determines how verbose the EKF3 streaming logging is. A value of 0 provides full logging(default), a value of 1 only XKF4 scaled innovations are logged, a value of 2 both XKF4 and GSF are logged, and a value of 3 disables all streaming logging of EKF3.

param.name: TEMP_LOG

values.value: Log only instances with sensor source set to None

param.name: INS_LOG_BAT_CNT
param.documentation: Number of samples to take when logging streams of IMU sensor readings. Will be rounded down to a multiple of 32. This option takes effect on the next reboot.

param.name: INS_LOG_BAT_LGIN
param.documentation: Interval between pushing samples to the AP_Logger log

param.name: INS_LOG_BAT_LGCT
param.documentation: Number of samples to push to count every INS_LOG_BAT_LGIN

param.name: LOG_MAX_FILES
param.documentation: This sets the maximum number of log file that will be written on dataflash or sd card before starting to rotate log number. Limit is capped at 500 logs.

param.humanName: Old logs on the SD card will be deleted to maintain this amount of free space
param.name: LOG_FILE_MB_FREE
param.documentation: Set this such that the free space is larger than your largest typical flight log

param.name: LOG_BACKEND_TYPE
param.documentation: Bitmap of what Logger backend types to enable. Block-based logging is available on SITL and boards with dataflash chips. Multiple backends can be selected.

param.humanName: Stop logging to current file on disarm
param.name: LOG_FILE_DSRMROT
param.documentation: When set, the current log file is closed when the vehicle is disarmed. If LOG_DISARMED is set then a fresh log will be opened. Applies to the File and Block logging backends.

param.humanName: Maximum AP_Logger MAVLink Backend buffer size
param.name: LOG_MAV_BUFSIZE
param.documentation: Maximum amount of memory to allocate to AP_Logger-over-mavlink

param.humanName: Timeout before giving up on file writes
param.name: LOG_FILE_TIMEOUT
param.documentation: This controls the amount of time before failing writes to a log file cause the file to be closed and logging stopped.

param.humanName: Maximum logging rate for file backend
param.name: LOG_FILE_RATEMAX
param.documentation: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to the file backend. A value of zero means that rate limiting is disabled.

param.humanName: Maximum logging rate for mavlink backend
param.name: LOG_MAV_RATEMAX
param.documentation: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to the mavlink backend. A value of zero means that rate limiting is disabled.

param.humanName: Maximum logging rate for block backend
param.name: LOG_BLK_RATEMAX
param.documentation: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to the block backend. A value of zero means that rate limiting is disabled.

param.name: LOG_DARM_RATEMAX
param.documentation: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to any backend when disarmed. A value of zero means that the normal backend rate limit is applied.

param.humanName: Logging File and Block Backend buffer size max (in kibibytes)
param.name: LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE
param.documentation: The File and Block backends use a buffer to store data before writing to the block device. Raising this value may reduce "gaps" in your SD card logging but increases memory usage. This buffer size may be reduced to free up available memory

param.name: LOG_DISARMED
param.documentation: If LOG_DISARMED is set to 1 then logging will be enabled at all times including when disarmed. Logging before arming can make for very large logfiles but can help a lot when tracking down startup issues and is necessary if logging of EKF replay data is selected via the LOG_REPLAY parameter. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 2, then logging will be enabled when disarmed, but not if a USB connection is detected. This can be used to prevent unwanted data logs being generated when the vehicle is connected via USB for log downloading or parameter changes. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 3 then logging will happen while disarmed, but if the vehicle never arms then the logs using the filesystem backend will be discarded on the next boot.

values.value: Discard log on reboot if never armed

param.humanName: Enable logging of information needed for Replay
param.name: LOG_REPLAY
param.documentation: If LOG_REPLAY is set to 1 then the EKF2 and EKF3 state estimators will log detailed information needed for diagnosing problems with the Kalman filter. LOG_DISARMED must be set to 1 or 2 or else the log will not contain the pre-flight data required for replay testing of the EKF's. It is suggested that you also raise LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE to give more buffer space for logging and use a high quality microSD card to ensure no sensor data is lost.

param.name: NTF_DISPLAY_TYPE
param.documentation: This sets up the type of on-board I2C display. Disabled by default.

param.name: SIM_WIND_SPD
param.documentation: Allows you to emulate wind in sim

param.humanName: Direction simulated wind is coming from
param.name: SIM_WIND_DIR
param.documentation: Allows you to set wind direction (true deg) in sim

param.name: SIM_WIND_TURB
param.documentation: Allows you to emulate random wind variations in sim

param.name: SIM_WIND_TC
param.documentation: this controls the time over which wind changes take effect

param.name: SIM_WIND_DIR_Z
param.documentation: Allows you to set vertical wind direction (true deg) in sim. 0 means pure horizontal wind. 90 means pure updraft.

param.name: SIM_WIND_T
param.documentation: Selects how wind varies from surface to WIND_T_ALT

param.name: SIM_WIND_T_ALT
param.documentation: Altitude at which wind reaches full strength, decaying from full strength as altitude lowers to ground level

param.name: SIM_WIND_T_COEF
param.documentation: For linear wind profile,wind is reduced by (Altitude-WIND_T_ALT) x this value

param.name: SIM_WAVE_ENABLE
param.documentation: Wave enable and modes

param.name: SIM_WAVE_LENGTH
param.documentation: Wave length in SITL

param.name: SIM_WAVE_AMP
param.documentation: Wave amplitude in SITL

param.name: SIM_WAVE_DIR
param.documentation: Direction wave is coming from

param.name: SIM_WAVE_SPEED
param.documentation: Wave speed in SITL

param.name: SIM_TIDE_DIR
param.documentation: Tide direction wave is coming from

param.name: SIM_TIDE_SPEED
param.documentation: Tide speed in simulation

param.name: SIM_THML_SCENARI
param.documentation: Scenario for thermalling simulation, for soaring

param.name: SCHED_DEBUG
param.documentation: Set to non-zero to enable scheduler debug messages. When set to show "Slips" the scheduler will display a message whenever a scheduled task is delayed due to too much CPU load. When set to ShowOverruns the scheduled will display a message whenever a task takes longer than the limit promised in the task table.

param.name: EK3_LOG_LEVEL
param.documentation: Determines how verbose the EKF3 streaming logging is. A value of 0 provides full logging(default), a value of 1 only XKF4 scaled innovations are logged, a value of 2 both XKF4 and GSF are logged, and a value of 3 disables all streaming logging of EKF3.

param.name: PRX_LOG_RAW
param.documentation: Set this parameter to one if logging unfiltered(raw) distances from sensor should be enabled

param.name: TEMP_LOG
param.documentation: Enables temperature sensor logging

values.value: Log only instances with sensor source set to None

Note that if you want to reduce log sizes you should consider using LOG_FILE_RATEMAX instead of disabling logging items with this parameter.

param.name: ArduCopter:FS_VIBE_ENABLE

param.name: ArduCopter:FS_DR_TIMEOUT
param.documentation: DeadReckoning is available for this many seconds after losing position and/or velocity source. After this timeout elapses the EKF failsafe will trigger in modes requiring a position estimate

param.name: ArduCopter:FS_EKF_FILT
param.documentation: EKF Failsafe filter cutoff frequency. EKF variances are filtered using this value to avoid spurious failsafes from transient high variances. A higher value means the failsafe is more likely to trigger.

param.name: LOG_BACKEND_TYPE
param.documentation: Bitmap of what Logger backend types to enable. Block-based logging is available on SITL and boards with dataflash chips. Multiple backends can be selected.

param.humanName: Maximum logging rate for block backend
param.name: LOG_BLK_RATEMAX
param.documentation: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to the block backend. A value of zero means that rate limiting is disabled.

param.name: LOG_DARM_RATEMAX
param.documentation: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to any backend when disarmed. A value of zero means that the normal backend rate limit is applied.

param.name: LOG_DISARMED
param.documentation: If LOG_DISARMED is set to 1 then logging will be enabled at all times including when disarmed. Logging before arming can make for very large logfiles but can help a lot when tracking down startup issues and is necessary if logging of EKF replay data is selected via the LOG_REPLAY parameter. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 2, then logging will be enabled when disarmed, but not if a USB connection is detected. This can be used to prevent unwanted data logs being generated when the vehicle is connected via USB for log downloading or parameter changes. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 3 then logging will happen while disarmed, but if the vehicle never arms then the logs using the filesystem backend will be discarded on the next boot.

values.value: Discard log on reboot if never armed

param.humanName: Logging File and Block Backend buffer size max (in kibibytes)
param.name: LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE
param.documentation: The File and Block backends use a buffer to store data before writing to the block device. Raising this value may reduce "gaps" in your SD card logging but increases memory usage. This buffer size may be reduced to free up available memory

param.humanName: Stop logging to current file on disarm
param.name: LOG_FILE_DSRMROT
param.documentation: When set, the current log file is closed when the vehicle is disarmed. If LOG_DISARMED is set then a fresh log will be opened. Applies to the File and Block logging backends.

param.humanName: Old logs on the SD card will be deleted to maintain this amount of free space
param.name: LOG_FILE_MB_FREE
param.documentation: Set this such that the free space is larger than your largest typical flight log

param.humanName: Maximum logging rate for file backend
param.name: LOG_FILE_RATEMAX
param.documentation: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to the file backend. A value of zero means that rate limiting is disabled.

param.humanName: Timeout before giving up on file writes
param.name: LOG_FILE_TIMEOUT
param.documentation: This controls the amount of time before failing writes to a log file cause the file to be closed and logging stopped.

param.humanName: Maximum AP_Logger MAVLink Backend buffer size
param.name: LOG_MAV_BUFSIZE
param.documentation: Maximum amount of memory to allocate to AP_Logger-over-mavlink

param.humanName: Maximum logging rate for mavlink backend
param.name: LOG_MAV_RATEMAX
param.documentation: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to the mavlink backend. A value of zero means that rate limiting is disabled.

param.name: LOG_MAX_FILES
param.documentation: This sets the maximum number of log file that will be written on dataflash or sd card before starting to rotate log number. Limit is capped at 500 logs.

param.humanName: Enable logging of information needed for Replay
param.name: LOG_REPLAY
param.documentation: If LOG_REPLAY is set to 1 then the EKF2 and EKF3 state estimators will log detailed information needed for diagnosing problems with the Kalman filter. LOG_DISARMED must be set to 1 or 2 or else the log will not contain the pre-flight data required for replay testing of the EKF's. It is suggested that you also raise LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE to give more buffer space for logging and use a high quality microSD card to ensure no sensor data is lost.

param.name: LOIT_ACC_MAX_M
param.documentation: Loiter maximum correction acceleration in m/s/s. Higher values cause the copter to correct position errors more aggressively.

param.name: LOIT_ANG_MAX
param.documentation: Loiter maximum pilot requested lean angle. Set to zero for 2/3 of PSC_ANGLE_MAX/ATC_ANGLE_MAX. The maximum vehicle lean angle is still limited by PSC_ANGLE_MAX/ATC_ANGLE_MAX

param.name: LOIT_BRK_ACC_M
param.documentation: Loiter braking acceleration in m/s/s. Higher values stop the copter more quickly when the stick is centered.

param.name: LOIT_BRK_DELAY
param.documentation: Loiter brake start delay (in seconds)

param.name: LOIT_BRK_JRK_M
param.documentation: Loiter braking jerk in m/s/s/s. Higher values will remove braking faster if the pilot moves the sticks during a braking maneuver.

param.name: LOIT_SPEED_MS
param.documentation: Defines the maximum speed in m/s which the aircraft will travel horizontally while in loiter mode

param.documentation: Altitude the vehicle will move to as the final stage of Returning to Launch or after completing a mission. Set to zero to land.

param.name: RTL_ALT_M
param.documentation: The minimum alt above home the vehicle will climb to before returning. If the vehicle is flying higher than this value it will return at its current altitude.

param.name: RTL_CLIMB_MIN_M
param.documentation: The vehicle will climb this many meters during the initial climb portion of the RTL

param.name: RTL_SPEED_MS
param.documentation: The speed in m/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain horizontally while flying home. If this is set to zero, WP_SPD will be used instead.

param.name: SCHED_DEBUG
param.documentation: Set to non-zero to enable scheduler debug messages. When set to show "Slips" the scheduler will display a message whenever a scheduled task is delayed due to too much CPU load. When set to ShowOverruns the scheduled will display a message whenever a task takes longer than the limit promised in the task table.

param.name: BATT_IDX
param.documentation: Ensure this battery is configured with `BATT*_MONITOR=29`.

param.name: ARMING_ACCTHRESH
param.documentation: Accelerometer error threshold used to determine inconsistent accelerometers. Compares this error range to other accelerometers to detect a hardware or calibration error. Lower value means tighter check and harder to pass arming check. Not all accelerometers are created equal.

param.name: ARMING_RUDDER
param.documentation: Allow arm/disarm by rudder input. When enabled arming can be done with right rudder, disarming with left rudder. Rudder arming only works with throttle at zero +- deadzone (RCx_DZ). Depending on vehicle type, arming in certain modes is prevented. See the wiki for each vehicle. Caution is recommended when arming if it is allowed in an auto-throttle mode!

param.name: ARMING_MIS_ITEMS
param.documentation: Bitmask of mission items that are required to be planned in order to arm the aircraft

param.name: ARMING_OPTIONS
param.documentation: Options that can be applied to change arming behaviour

bitmask.bit: Do not send status text on state change
Skip IMU consistency checks when ICE motor running

param.field: 0:Disable prearm display,1:Do not send status text on state change,2:Skip IMU consistency checks when ICE motor running

param.humanName: Compass magnetic field strength error threshold vs earth magnetic model
param.name: ARMING_MAGTHRESH
param.documentation: Compass magnetic field strength error threshold vs earth magnetic model. X and y axis are compared using this threhold, Z axis uses 2x this threshold. 0 to disable check

param.name: ARMING_NEED_LOC
param.documentation: Require that the vehicle have an absolute position before it arms. This can help ensure that the vehicle can Return To Launch.

param.name: ARMING_SKIPCHK
param.documentation: Checks to skip prior to arming motor. This is a bitmask of checks before allowing arming that will be skipped. For most users it is recommended to leave this at the default of 0 (no checks skipped). In extreme circumstances, a value of -1 can be used to skip all non-mandatory current and future checks.
param.field: 1:Barometer,2:Compass,3:GPS lock,4:INS,5:Parameters,6:RC Channels,7:Board voltage,8:Battery Level,10:Logging Available,11:Hardware safety switch,12:GPS Configuration,13:System,14:Mission,15:Rangefinder,16:Camera,17:AuxAuth,18:VisualOdometry,19:FFT

param.name: BATT_MONITOR
param.documentation: Controls enabling monitoring of the battery's voltage and current

param.name: BATT_CAPACITY
param.documentation: Capacity of the battery in mAh when full

param.name: BATT_SERIAL_NUM
param.documentation: Battery serial number, automatically filled in for SMBus batteries, otherwise will be -1. With DroneCan it is the battery_id.

param.name: BATT_LOW_TIMER
param.documentation: This is the timeout in seconds before a low voltage event will be triggered. For aircraft with low C batteries it may be necessary to raise this in order to cope with low voltage on long takeoffs. A value of zero disables low voltage errors.

param.name: BATT_FS_VOLTSRC
param.documentation: Voltage type used for detection of low voltage event

param.name: BATT_LOW_VOLT
param.documentation: Battery voltage that triggers a low battery failsafe. Set to 0 to disable. If the battery voltage drops below this voltage continuously for more then the period specified by the BATT_LOW_TIMER parameter then the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT_FS_LOW_ACT parameter.

param.name: BATT_LOW_MAH
param.documentation: Battery capacity at which the low battery failsafe is triggered. Set to 0 to disable battery remaining failsafe. If the battery capacity drops below this level the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT_FS_LOW_ACT parameter.

param.name: BATT_CRT_VOLT
param.documentation: Battery voltage that triggers a critical battery failsafe. Set to 0 to disable. If the battery voltage drops below this voltage continuously for more then the period specified by the BATT_LOW_TIMER parameter then the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT_FS_CRT_ACT parameter.

param.name: BATT_CRT_MAH
param.documentation: Battery capacity at which the critical battery failsafe is triggered. Set to 0 to disable battery remaining failsafe. If the battery capacity drops below this level the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT_FS_CRT_ACT parameter.

param.name: BATT_FS_LOW_ACT
param.documentation: What action the vehicle should perform if it hits a low battery failsafe

param.name: BATT_FS_CRT_ACT
param.documentation: What action the vehicle should perform if it hits a critical battery failsafe

param.name: BATT_ARM_VOLT
param.documentation: Battery voltage level which is required to arm the aircraft. Set to 0 to allow arming at any voltage.

param.name: BATT_ARM_MAH
param.documentation: Battery capacity remaining which is required to arm the aircraft. Set to 0 to allow arming at any capacity. Note that execept for smart batteries rebooting the vehicle will always reset the remaining capacity estimate, which can lead to this check not providing sufficent protection, it is recommended to always use this in conjunction with the BATT_ARM_VOLT parameter.

param.name: BATT_OPTIONS
param.documentation: This sets options to change the behaviour of the battery monitor

bitmask.bit: MPPT reports input voltage and current
Send resistance compensated voltage to GCS
Allow DroneCAN InfoAux to be from a different CAN node
Battery is for internal autopilot use only
Sum monitor measures minimum voltage instead of average
Allow DroneCAN dynamic node update on hot-swap

param.field: 0:Ignore DroneCAN SoC, 1:MPPT reports input voltage and current, 2:MPPT Powered off when disarmed, 3:MPPT Powered on when armed, 4:MPPT Powered off at boot, 5:MPPT Powered on at boot, 6:Send resistance compensated voltage to GCS, 7:Allow DroneCAN InfoAux to be from a different CAN node, 8:Battery is for internal autopilot use only, 9:Sum monitor measures minimum voltage instead of average, 10:Allow DroneCAN dynamic node update on hot-swap

param.humanName: ESC Telemetry Index to write to
param.name: BATT_ESC_INDEX
param.documentation: ESC Telemetry Index to write voltage, current, consumption and temperature data to. Use 0 to disable.

param.name: BATT_SUM_MASK
param.documentation: 0: sum of remaining battery monitors, If none 0 sum of specified monitors. Current will be summed and voltages averaged.

param.name: BATT_CURR_MULT
param.documentation: Multiplier applied to all current related reports to allow for adjustment if no UAVCAN param access or current splitting applications

param.name: BATT_MAX_VOLT
param.documentation: Maximum voltage of battery. Provides scaling of current versus voltage

param.name: BATT_ESC_MASK
param.documentation: If 0 all connected ESCs will be used. If non-zero, only those selected in will be used.

param.name: BATT_CHANNEL
param.documentation: INA3221 channel to return data for

param.name: RC_OVERRIDE_TIME
param.documentation: Timeout after which RC overrides will no longer be used, and RC input will resume, 0 will disable RC overrides, -1 will never timeout, and continue using overrides until they are disabled

param.name: RC_OPTIONS
param.documentation: RC input options

bitmask.bit: Ignore Receiver Failsafe bit but allow other RC failsafes if setup
Skip the arming check for neutral Roll/Pitch/Yaw sticks
Suppress CRSF mode/rate message for ELRS systems
Use Link Quality for RSSI with CRSF
Annotate CRSF flight mode with * on disarm

param.name: RC_PROTOCOLS

param.name: RC_FS_TIMEOUT

param.name: SERIAL0_BAUD
param.documentation: The baud rate used on the USB console. Most stm32-based boards can support rates of up to 1500. If you setup a rate you cannot support and then can't connect to your board you should load a firmware from a different vehicle type. That will reset all your parameters to defaults.

param.documentation: Control what protocol to use on the console.

param.name: SERIAL1_OPTIONS
param.documentation: Control over UART options. The InvertRX option controls invert of the receive pin. The InvertTX option controls invert of the transmit pin. The HalfDuplex option controls half-duplex (onewire) mode, where both transmit and receive is done on the transmit wire. The Swap option allows the RX and TX pins to be swapped on STM32F7 based boards. NOTE that two bits have moved from this parameter into MAVn_OPTIONS!

bitmask.bit: Don't forward mavlink to/from (moved to MAVn_OPTIONS >4.7)

param.field: 0:InvertRX, 1:InvertTX, 2:HalfDuplex, 3:SwapTXRX, 4: RX_PullDown, 5: RX_PullUp, 6: TX_PullDown, 7: TX_PullUp, 8: RX_NoDMA, 9: TX_NoDMA, 10: Don't forward mavlink to/from (moved to MAVn_OPTIONS >4.7), 11: DisableFIFO, 12: Ignore Streamrate (moved to MAVn_OPTIONS >4.7)

param.name: SERVO_RATE
param.documentation: Default output rate in Hz for all PWM outputs.

param.name: SERVO_DSHOT_RATE
param.documentation: DShot output rate for all outputs as a multiple of the loop rate. 0 sets the output rate to be fixed at 1Khz for low loop rates. This value should never be set below 500Hz.

param.name: SERVO_DSHOT_ESC
param.documentation: DShot ESC type for all outputs. The ESC type affects the range of DShot commands available and the bit widths used. None means that no dshot commands will be executed. Some ESC types support Extended DShot Telemetry (EDT) which allows telemetry other than RPM data to be returned when using bi-directional dshot. If you enable EDT you must install EDT capable firmware for correct operation.

param.name: SERVO_GPIO_MASK
param.documentation: Bitmask of outputs which will be available as GPIOs. Any output with either the function set to -1 or with the corresponding bit set in this mask will be available for use as a GPIO pin

param.name: SERVO_RC_FS_MSK
param.documentation: Bitmask of scaled passthru output channels which will be set to their trim value during rc failsafe instead of holding their last position before failsafe.

param.name: SERVO_32_ENABLE
param.documentation: This allows for up to 32 outputs, enabling parameters for outputs above 16

param.name: SERVO1_MIN
param.documentation: minimum PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.

param.name: SERVO1_MAX
param.documentation: maximum PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.

param.name: SERVO1_TRIM
param.documentation: Trim PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.

param.name: SERVO1_REVERSED
param.documentation: Reverse servo operation. Set to 0 for normal operation. Set to 1 to reverse this output channel.

param.name: SERVO1_FUNCTION
param.documentation: Function assigned to this servo. Setting this to Disabled(0) will setup this output for control by auto missions or MAVLink servo set commands. any other value will enable the corresponding function

param.humanName: BLHeli pass-thru auto-enable for multicopter motors
param.name: SERVO_BLH_AUTO
param.documentation: If set to 1 this auto-enables BLHeli pass-thru support for all multicopter motors

param.name: SERVO_BLH_TMOUT
param.documentation: This sets the inactivity timeout for the BLHeli protocol in seconds. If no packets are received in this time normal MAVLink operations are resumed. A value of 0 means no timeout

param.name: SERVO_BLH_TRATE
param.documentation: This sets the rate in Hz for requesting telemetry from ESCs. It is the rate per ESC. Setting to zero disables telemetry requests

param.name: SERVO_BLH_DEBUG
param.documentation: When set to 1 this enabled verbose debugging output over MAVLink when the blheli protocol is active. This can be used to diagnose failures.

param.name: SERVO_BLH_POLES
param.documentation: This allows calculation of true RPM from ESC's eRPM. The default is 14.

param.name: SERVO_FTW_POLES
param.documentation: Number of motor electrical poles

param.name: SERVO_ROB_POSMIN
param.documentation: Position minimum at servo min value. This should be within the position control range of the servos, normally 0 to 4095

param.name: SERVO_ROB_POSMAX
param.documentation: Position maximum at servo max value. This should be within the position control range of the servos, normally 0 to 4095

param.name: SERVO_SBUS_RATE
param.documentation: This sets the SBUS output frame rate in Hz.

param.name: SERVO_VOLZ_RANGE
param.documentation: Range to map between 1000 and 2000 PWM. Default value of 200 gives full +-100 deg range of extended position command. This results in 0.2 deg movement per US change in PWM. If the full range is not needed it can be reduced to increase resolution. 40 deg range gives 0.04 deg movement per US change in PWM, this is higher resolution than possible with the VOLZ protocol so further reduction in range will not improve resolution. Reduced range does allow PWMs outside the 1000 to 2000 range, with 40 deg range 750 PWM results in a angle of -30 deg, 2250 would be +30 deg. This is still limited by the 200 deg maximum range of the actuator.

param.name: ArduPlane:AIRSPEED_CRUISE
param.documentation: Target cruise airspeed in m/s in automatic throttle modes. Value is as an indicated (calibrated/apparent) airspeed.

param.name: ArduPlane:AIRSPEED_MAX
param.documentation: Maximum airspeed demanded in automatic throttle modes. Should be set slightly less than level flight speed at THR_MAX and also at least 50% above AIRSPEED_MIN to allow for accurate TECS altitude control.

param.name: ArduPlane:AIRSPEED_MIN
param.documentation: Minimum airspeed demanded in automatic throttle modes. Should be set to 20% higher than level flight stall speed.

param.name: ArduPlane:FLTMODE1
param.documentation: Flight mode for switch position 1 (910 to 1230 and above 2049)

param.name: ArduPlane:FLTMODE2
param.documentation: Flight mode for switch position 2 (1231 to 1360)

param.name: ArduPlane:FLTMODE3
param.documentation: Flight mode for switch position 3 (1361 to 1490)

param.name: ArduPlane:FLTMODE4
param.documentation: Flight mode for switch position 4 (1491 to 1620)

param.name: ArduPlane:FLTMODE5
param.documentation: Flight mode for switch position 5 (1621 to 1749)

param.name: ArduPlane:FLTMODE6
param.documentation: Flight mode for switch position 6 (1750 to 2049)

param.name: ArduPlane:FLTMODE_CH
param.documentation: RC Channel to use for flight mode control

param.name: ArduPlane:LOG_BITMASK
param.documentation: Bitmap of what on-board log types to enable. This value is made up of the sum of each of the log types you want to be saved. It is usually best just to enable all basic log types by setting this to 65535.
param.field: 0:Fast Attitude,1:Medium Attitude,2:GPS,3:Performance,4:Control Tuning,5:Navigation Tuning,7:IMU,8:Mission Commands,9:Battery Monitor,10:Compass,11:TECS,12:Camera,13:RC Input-Output,14:Rangefinder,19:Raw IMU,20:Fullrate Attitude,21:Video Stabilization,22:Fullrate Notch

param.name: ArduPlane:PTCH_LIM_MAX_DEG
param.documentation: Maximum pitch up angle commanded in modes with stabilized limits.

param.name: ArduPlane:PTCH_LIM_MIN_DEG
param.documentation: Maximum pitch down angle commanded in modes with stabilized limits

param.name: ArduPlane:RTL_ALTITUDE
param.documentation: Target altitude above home for RTL mode. Maintains current altitude if set to -1. Rally point altitudes are used if plane does not return to home.

param.name: ArduPlane:RTL_CLIMB_MIN
param.documentation: The vehicle will climb this many m during the initial climb portion of the RTL. During this time the roll will be limited to LEVEL_ROLL_LIMIT degrees.

param.name: ArduPlane:RTL_RADIUS
param.documentation: Defines the radius of the loiter circle when in RTL mode. If this is zero then WP_LOITER_RAD is used. If the radius is negative then a counter-clockwise is used. If positive then a clockwise loiter is used. For quadplanes with Q_RTL_MODE set to 1 (Enabled), this value is used to set the minimum radius at which the plane will transition from fixed-wing to VTOL mode for landing.

param.name: ArduPlane:THR_MAX
param.documentation: Maximum throttle percentage used in all modes except manual, provided THR_PASS_STAB is not set.

param.name: ArduPlane:THR_MIN
param.documentation: Minimum throttle percentage used in all modes except manual, provided THR_PASS_STAB is not set. Negative values allow reverse thrust if hardware supports it.

param.name: ArduPlane:THR_SLEWRATE
param.documentation: Maximum change in throttle percentage per second. Lower limit based on 1 microsend of servo increase per loop. Divide SCHED_LOOP_RATE by approximately 10 to determine minimum achievable value.

param.name: ArduPlane:TRIM_THROTTLE
param.documentation: Target percentage of throttle to apply for flight in automatic throttle modes and throttle percentage that maintains AIRSPEED_CRUISE. Caution: low battery voltages at the end of flights may require higher throttle to maintain airspeed.

param.name: ArduPlane:WP_LOITER_RAD
param.documentation: Defines the distance from the waypoint center, the plane will maintain during a loiter. If you set this value to a negative number then the default loiter direction will be counter-clockwise instead of clockwise. If this value is too close to zero, the achieved loiter radius will be determined by ROLL_LIMIT_DEG.

param.name: ArduPlane:WP_MAX_RADIUS
param.documentation: Sets the maximum distance to a waypoint for the waypoint to be considered complete. This overrides the "cross the finish line" logic that is normally used to consider a waypoint complete. For normal AUTO behaviour this parameter should be set to zero. Using a non-zero value is only recommended when it is critical that the aircraft does approach within the given radius, and should loop around until it has done so. This can cause the aircraft to loop forever if its turn radius is greater than the maximum radius set.

param.name: ArduPlane:WP_RADIUS
param.documentation: Defines the maximum distance from a waypoint that when crossed indicates the waypoint may be complete. To avoid the aircraft looping around the waypoint in case it misses by more than the WP_RADIUS an additional check is made to see if the aircraft has crossed a "finish line" passing through the waypoint and perpendicular to the flight path from the previous waypoint. If that finish line is crossed then the waypoint is considered complete. Note that the navigation controller may decide to turn later than WP_RADIUS before a waypoint, based on how sharp the turn is and the speed of the aircraft. It is safe to set WP_RADIUS much larger than the usual turn radius of your aircraft and the navigation controller will work out when to turn. If you set WP_RADIUS too small then you will tend to overshoot the turns.

param.documentation: Number of samples to take when logging streams of IMU sensor readings. Will be rounded down to a multiple of 32. This option takes effect on the next reboot.

param.documentation: Number of samples to push to count every INS_LOG_BAT_LGIN

param.name: INS_LOG_BAT_LGIN

param.name: LOG_BACKEND_TYPE
param.documentation: Bitmap of what Logger backend types to enable. Block-based logging is available on SITL and boards with dataflash chips. Multiple backends can be selected.

param.humanName: Maximum logging rate for block backend
param.name: LOG_BLK_RATEMAX
param.documentation: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to the block backend. A value of zero means that rate limiting is disabled.

param.name: LOG_DARM_RATEMAX
param.documentation: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to any backend when disarmed. A value of zero means that the normal backend rate limit is applied.

param.name: LOG_DISARMED
param.documentation: If LOG_DISARMED is set to 1 then logging will be enabled at all times including when disarmed. Logging before arming can make for very large logfiles but can help a lot when tracking down startup issues and is necessary if logging of EKF replay data is selected via the LOG_REPLAY parameter. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 2, then logging will be enabled when disarmed, but not if a USB connection is detected. This can be used to prevent unwanted data logs being generated when the vehicle is connected via USB for log downloading or parameter changes. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 3 then logging will happen while disarmed, but if the vehicle never arms then the logs using the filesystem backend will be discarded on the next boot.

values.value: Discard log on reboot if never armed

param.humanName: Logging File and Block Backend buffer size max (in kibibytes)
param.name: LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE
param.documentation: The File and Block backends use a buffer to store data before writing to the block device. Raising this value may reduce "gaps" in your SD card logging but increases memory usage. This buffer size may be reduced to free up available memory

param.humanName: Stop logging to current file on disarm
param.name: LOG_FILE_DSRMROT
param.documentation: When set, the current log file is closed when the vehicle is disarmed. If LOG_DISARMED is set then a fresh log will be opened. Applies to the File and Block logging backends.

param.humanName: Old logs on the SD card will be deleted to maintain this amount of free space
param.name: LOG_FILE_MB_FREE
param.documentation: Set this such that the free space is larger than your largest typical flight log

param.humanName: Maximum logging rate for file backend
param.name: LOG_FILE_RATEMAX
param.documentation: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to the file backend. A value of zero means that rate limiting is disabled.

param.humanName: Timeout before giving up on file writes
param.name: LOG_FILE_TIMEOUT
param.documentation: This controls the amount of time before failing writes to a log file cause the file to be closed and logging stopped.

param.humanName: Maximum AP_Logger MAVLink Backend buffer size
param.name: LOG_MAV_BUFSIZE
param.documentation: Maximum amount of memory to allocate to AP_Logger-over-mavlink

param.humanName: Maximum logging rate for mavlink backend
param.name: LOG_MAV_RATEMAX
param.documentation: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to the mavlink backend. A value of zero means that rate limiting is disabled.

param.name: LOG_MAX_FILES
param.documentation: This sets the maximum number of log file that will be written on dataflash or sd card before starting to rotate log number. Limit is capped at 500 logs.

param.humanName: Enable logging of information needed for Replay
param.name: LOG_REPLAY
param.documentation: If LOG_REPLAY is set to 1 then the EKF2 and EKF3 state estimators will log detailed information needed for diagnosing problems with the Kalman filter. LOG_DISARMED must be set to 1 or 2 or else the log will not contain the pre-flight data required for replay testing of the EKF's. It is suggested that you also raise LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE to give more buffer space for logging and use a high quality microSD card to ensure no sensor data is lost.

param.name: MIS_TOTAL
param.documentation: The number of mission mission items that has been loaded by the ground station. Do not change this manually.

param.name: NAVL1_DAMPING
param.documentation: Damping ratio for L1 control. Increase this in increments of 0.05 if you are getting overshoot in path tracking. You should not need a value below 0.7 or above 0.85.

param.name: NAVL1_LIM_BANK
param.documentation: The sealevel bank angle limit for a continuous loiter. (Used to calculate airframe loading limits at higher altitudes). Setting to 0, will instead just scale the loiter radius directly

param.name: NAVL1_PERIOD
param.documentation: Period in seconds of L1 tracking loop. This parameter is the primary control for aggressiveness of turns in auto mode. This needs to be larger for less responsive airframes. The default is quite conservative, but for most RC aircraft will lead to reasonable flight. For smaller more agile aircraft a value closer to 15 is appropriate, or even as low as 10 for some very agile aircraft. When tuning, change this value in small increments, as a value that is much too small (say 5 or 10 below the right value) can lead to very radical turns, and a risk of stalling.

param.name: NTF_DISPLAY_TYPE
param.documentation: This sets up the type of on-board I2C display. Disabled by default.

param.name: Q_LAND_FINAL_ALT
param.documentation: The altitude at which we should switch to Q_LAND_FINAL_SPD descent rate

param.name: Q_LAND_FINAL_SPD
param.documentation: The descent speed for the final stage of landing in m/s

param.name: Q_PILOT_ACCEL_Z
param.documentation: The vertical acceleration used when pilot is controlling the altitude

param.name: Q_PILOT_SPD_DN
param.documentation: The maximum vertical velocity the pilot may request in m/s going down. If 0, uses Q_PILOT_SPD_UP value.

param.name: Q_PILOT_SPD_UP
param.documentation: The maximum ascending vertical velocity the pilot may request in m/s

param.name: Q_RTL_ALT
param.documentation: The altitude which QRTL mode heads to initially

param.name: Q_RTL_MODE
param.documentation: If this is set to 1 then an RTL will change to QRTL when within RTL_RADIUS meters of the RTL destination, VTOL approach: vehicle will RTL at RTL alt and circle with a radius of Q_FW_LND_APR_RAD down to Q_RTL_ALT and then transition into the wind and QRTL, see 'AUTO VTOL Landing', QRTL Always: do a QRTL instead of RTL

param.name: Q_LOIT_ACC_MAX_M
param.documentation: Loiter maximum correction acceleration in m/s/s. Higher values cause the copter to correct position errors more aggressively.

param.name: Q_LOIT_ANG_MAX
param.documentation: Loiter maximum pilot requested lean angle. Set to zero for 2/3 of Q_P_ANGLE_MAX/Q_A_ANGLE_MAX. The maximum vehicle lean angle is still limited by Q_P_ANGLE_MAX/Q_A_ANGLE_MAX

param.name: Q_LOIT_BRK_ACC_M
param.documentation: Loiter braking acceleration in m/s/s. Higher values stop the copter more quickly when the stick is centered.

param.name: Q_LOIT_BRK_DELAY
param.documentation: Loiter brake start delay (in seconds)

param.name: Q_LOIT_BRK_JRK_M
param.documentation: Loiter braking jerk in m/s/s/s. Higher values will remove braking faster if the pilot moves the sticks during a braking maneuver.

param.name: Q_LOIT_SPEED_MS
param.documentation: Defines the maximum speed in m/s which the aircraft will travel horizontally while in loiter mode

param.name: Q_WP_ACC
param.documentation: Horizontal acceleration in m/s/s used during missions

param.name: Q_WP_ACC_Z
param.documentation: Vertical acceleration in m/s/s used during missions

param.name: Q_WP_RADIUS_M
param.documentation: Distance from a waypoint, that when crossed indicates the wp has been reached.

param.name: Q_WP_SPD
param.documentation: Speed in m/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain horizontally during a WP mission

param.name: Q_WP_SPD_DN
param.documentation: Speed in m/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while descending during a WP mission

param.name: Q_WP_SPD_UP
param.documentation: Speed in m/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while climbing during a WP mission

param.name: SCHED_DEBUG
param.documentation: Set to non-zero to enable scheduler debug messages. When set to show "Slips" the scheduler will display a message whenever a scheduled task is delayed due to too much CPU load. When set to ShowOverruns the scheduled will display a message whenever a task takes longer than the limit promised in the task table.

param.name: TECS_PTCH_DAMP
param.documentation: Damping gain for pitch control from TECS control. Increasing may correct for oscillations in speed and height, but too much may cause additional oscillation and degraded control.

param.name: TECS_SINK_MAX
param.documentation: Maximum demanded descent rate. Do not set higher than the vertical speed the aircraft can maintain at THR_MIN, TECS_PITCH_MIN, and AIRSPEED_MAX.

param.name: TECS_SPDWEIGHT
param.documentation: Mixing of pitch and throttle correction for height and airspeed errors. Pitch controls altitude and throttle controls airspeed if set to 0. Pitch controls airspeed and throttle controls altitude if set to 2 (good for gliders). Blended if set to 1.

param.name: TECS_THR_DAMP
param.documentation: Damping gain for throttle demand loop. Increase to add throttle activity to dampen oscillations in speed and height.

param.name: TECS_TIME_CONST
param.documentation: Time constant of the TECS control algorithm. Small values make faster altitude corrections but can cause overshoot and aggressive behavior.

param.name: RC1_MIN
param.documentation: RC minimum PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.

param.name: RC1_TRIM
param.documentation: RC trim (neutral) PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.

param.name: RC1_MAX
param.documentation: RC maximum PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.

param.name: RC1_REVERSED
param.documentation: Reverse channel input. Set to 0 for normal operation. Set to 1 to reverse this input channel.

param.name: RC1_DZ
param.documentation: PWM dead zone in microseconds around trim or bottom

param.name: RC1_OPTION
param.documentation: Function assigned to this RC channel

values.value: ArmDisarm with Quadplane AirMode (4.2 and higher)
Set roll pitch and yaw trim to current servo and RC
Test autotuned gains after tune is complete

param.name: SERVO_RATE
param.documentation: Default output rate in Hz for all PWM outputs.

param.name: SERVO_DSHOT_RATE
param.documentation: DShot output rate for all outputs as a multiple of the loop rate. 0 sets the output rate to be fixed at 1Khz for low loop rates. This value should never be set below 500Hz.

param.name: SERVO_DSHOT_ESC
param.documentation: DShot ESC type for all outputs. The ESC type affects the range of DShot commands available and the bit widths used. None means that no dshot commands will be executed. Some ESC types support Extended DShot Telemetry (EDT) which allows telemetry other than RPM data to be returned when using bi-directional dshot. If you enable EDT you must install EDT capable firmware for correct operation.

param.name: SERVO_GPIO_MASK
param.documentation: Bitmask of outputs which will be available as GPIOs. Any output with either the function set to -1 or with the corresponding bit set in this mask will be available for use as a GPIO pin

param.name: SERVO_RC_FS_MSK
param.documentation: Bitmask of scaled passthru output channels which will be set to their trim value during rc failsafe instead of holding their last position before failsafe.

param.name: SERVO_32_ENABLE
param.documentation: This allows for up to 32 outputs, enabling parameters for outputs above 16

param.name: SERVO_BLH_AUTO
param.documentation: If set to 1 this auto-enables BLHeli pass-thru support for all multicopter motors

param.name: SERVO_BLH_TMOUT
param.documentation: This sets the inactivity timeout for the BLHeli protocol in seconds. If no packets are received in this time normal MAVLink operations are resumed. A value of 0 means no timeout

param.name: SERVO_BLH_TRATE
param.documentation: This sets the rate in Hz for requesting telemetry from ESCs. It is the rate per ESC. Setting to zero disables telemetry requests

param.name: SERVO_BLH_DEBUG
param.documentation: When set to 1 this enabled verbose debugging output over MAVLink when the blheli protocol is active. This can be used to diagnose failures.

param.name: SERVO_ROB_POSMIN
param.documentation: Position minimum at servo min value. This should be within the position control range of the servos, normally 0 to 4095

param.name: SERVO_ROB_POSMAX
param.documentation: Position maximum at servo max value. This should be within the position control range of the servos, normally 0 to 4095

param.name: SERVO_SBUS_RATE
param.documentation: This sets the SBUS output frame rate in Hz.

param.name: SERVO_VOLZ_RANGE
param.documentation: Range to map between 1000 and 2000 PWM. Default value of 200 gives full +-100 deg range of extended position command. This results in 0.2 deg movement per US change in PWM. If the full range is not needed it can be reduced to increase resolution. 40 deg range gives 0.04 deg movement per US change in PWM, this is higher resolution than possible with the VOLZ protocol so further reduction in range will not improve resolution. Reduced range does allow PWMs outside the 1000 to 2000 range, with 40 deg range 750 PWM results in a angle of -30 deg, 2250 would be +30 deg. This is still limited by the 200 deg maximum range of the actuator.

param.humanName: Maximum AP_Logger File and Block Backend buffer size (in kilobytes)
param.name: LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE
param.documentation: The File and Block backends use a buffer to store data before writing to the block device. Raising this value may reduce "gaps" in your SD card logging. This buffer size may be reduced depending on available memory. PixHawk requires at least 4 kilobytes. Maximum value available here is 64 kilobytes.

param.name: LOG_DISARMED
param.documentation: If LOG_DISARMED is set to 1 then logging will be enabled at all times including when disarmed. Logging before arming can make for very large logfiles but can help a lot when tracking down startup issues and is necessary if logging of EKF replay data is selected via the LOG_REPLAY parameter. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 2, then logging will be enabled when disarmed, but not if a USB connection is detected. This can be used to prevent unwanted data logs being generated when the vehicle is connected via USB for log downloading or parameter changes. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 3 then logging will happen while disarmed, but if the vehicle never arms then the logs using the filesystem backend will be discarded on the next boot.

values.value: Discard log on reboot if never armed

param.humanName: Enable logging of information needed for Replay
param.name: LOG_REPLAY
param.documentation: If LOG_REPLAY is set to 1 then the EKF2 and EKF3 state estimators will log detailed information needed for diagnosing problems with the Kalman filter. LOG_DISARMED must be set to 1 or 2 or else the log will not contain the pre-flight data required for replay testing of the EKF's. It is suggested that you also raise LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE to give more buffer space for logging and use a high quality microSD card to ensure no sensor data is lost.

param.humanName: Stop logging to current file on disarm
param.name: LOG_FILE_DSRMROT
param.documentation: When set, the current log file is closed when the vehicle is disarmed. If LOG_DISARMED is set then a fresh log will be opened. Applies to the File and Block logging backends.

param.humanName: Maximum AP_Logger MAVLink Backend buffer size
param.name: LOG_MAV_BUFSIZE

param.humanName: Timeout before giving up on file writes
param.name: LOG_FILE_TIMEOUT
param.documentation: This controls the amount of time before failing writes to a log file cause the file to be closed and logging stopped.

param.name: WPNAV_SPEED
param.documentation: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain horizontally during a WP mission

param.name: WPNAV_RADIUS
param.documentation: Defines the distance from a waypoint, that when crossed indicates the wp has been hit.

param.name: WPNAV_SPEED_UP
param.documentation: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while climbing during a WP mission

param.name: WPNAV_SPEED_DN
param.documentation: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while descending during a WP mission

param.name: WPNAV_ACCEL
param.documentation: Defines the horizontal acceleration in cm/s/s used during missions

param.name: WPNAV_ACCEL_Z
param.documentation: Defines the vertical acceleration in cm/s/s used during missions

param.name: ARMING_ACCTHRESH
param.documentation: Accelerometer error threshold used to determine inconsistent accelerometers. Compares this error range to other accelerometers to detect a hardware or calibration error. Lower value means tighter check and harder to pass arming check. Not all accelerometers are created equal.

param.name: ARMING_RUDDER
param.documentation: Allow arm/disarm by rudder input. When enabled arming can be done with right rudder, disarming with left rudder. Rudder arming only works with throttle at zero +- deadzone (RCx_DZ). Depending on vehicle type, arming in certain modes is prevented. See the wiki for each vehicle. Caution is recommended when arming if it is allowed in an auto-throttle mode!

param.name: BATT_CAPACITY
param.documentation: Capacity of the battery in mAh when full

param.name: BATT_SERIAL_NUM
param.documentation: Battery serial number, automatically filled in for SMBus batteries, otherwise will be -1. With DroneCan it is the battery_id.

param.name: BATT_LOW_TIMER
param.documentation: This is the timeout in seconds before a low voltage event will be triggered. For aircraft with low C batteries it may be necessary to raise this in order to cope with low voltage on long takeoffs. A value of zero disables low voltage errors.

param.name: BATT_FS_VOLTSRC
param.documentation: Voltage type used for detection of low voltage event

param.name: BATT_LOW_VOLT
param.documentation: Battery voltage that triggers a low battery failsafe. Set to 0 to disable. If the battery voltage drops below this voltage continuously for more then the period specified by the BATT_LOW_TIMER parameter then the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT_FS_LOW_ACT parameter.

param.name: BATT_LOW_MAH
param.documentation: Battery capacity at which the low battery failsafe is triggered. Set to 0 to disable battery remaining failsafe. If the battery capacity drops below this level the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT_FS_LOW_ACT parameter.

param.name: BATT_CRT_VOLT
param.documentation: Battery voltage that triggers a critical battery failsafe. Set to 0 to disable. If the battery voltage drops below this voltage continuously for more then the period specified by the BATT_LOW_TIMER parameter then the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT_FS_CRT_ACT parameter.

param.name: BATT_ARM_VOLT
param.documentation: Battery voltage level which is required to arm the aircraft. Set to 0 to allow arming at any voltage.

param.name: BATT_MAX_VOLT
param.documentation: Maximum voltage of battery. Provides scaling of current versus voltage

param.name: RC_OVERRIDE_TIME
param.documentation: Timeout after which RC overrides will no longer be used, and RC input will resume, 0 will disable RC overrides, -1 will never timeout, and continue using overrides until they are disabled

param.humanName: BLHeli pass-thru auto-enable for multicopter motors
param.name: SERVO_BLH_AUTO
param.documentation: If set to 1 this auto-enables BLHeli pass-thru support for all multicopter motors

param.name: SERVO_BLH_TMOUT
param.documentation: This sets the inactivity timeout for the BLHeli protocol in seconds. If no packets are received in this time normal MAVLink operations are resumed. A value of 0 means no timeout

param.name: SERVO_BLH_TRATE
param.documentation: This sets the rate in Hz for requesting telemetry from ESCs. It is the rate per ESC. Setting to zero disables telemetry requests

param.name: SERVO_BLH_DEBUG
param.documentation: When set to 1 this enabled verbose debugging output over MAVLink when the blheli protocol is active. This can be used to diagnose failures.

param.name: SERVO_BLH_POLES
param.documentation: This allows calculation of true RPM from ESC's eRPM. The default is 14.

param.name: SERVO_FTW_POLES
param.documentation: Number of motor electrical poles

param.name: SERVO_ROB_POSMIN
param.documentation: Position minimum at servo min value. This should be within the position control range of the servos, normally 0 to 4095

param.name: SERVO_ROB_POSMAX
param.documentation: Position maximum at servo max value. This should be within the position control range of the servos, normally 0 to 4095

param.name: SERVO_SBUS_RATE
param.documentation: This sets the SBUS output frame rate in Hz.

param.name: ArduCopter:FORMAT_VERSION
param.documentation: This value is incremented when changes are made to the eeprom format

param.name: ArduCopter:RTL_ALT
param.documentation: The minimum alt above home the vehicle will climb to before returning. If the vehicle is flying higher than this value it will return at its current altitude.

param.name: ArduCopter:RTL_SPEED
param.documentation: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain horizontally while flying home. If this is set to zero, WPNAV_SPEED will be used instead.

param.name: ArduCopter:RTL_ALT_FINAL
param.documentation: This is the altitude the vehicle will move to as the final stage of Returning to Launch or after completing a mission. Set to zero to land.

param.name: ArduCopter:RTL_CLIMB_MIN
param.documentation: The vehicle will climb this many cm during the initial climb portion of the RTL

param.name: ArduCopter:RTL_LOIT_TIME
param.documentation: Time (in milliseconds) to loiter above home before beginning final descent

param.name: ArduCopter:WP_YAW_BEHAVIOR
param.documentation: Determines how the autopilot controls the yaw during missions and RTL

param.name: ArduCopter:LAND_SPEED_HIGH
param.documentation: The descent speed for the first stage of landing in cm/s. If this is zero then WPNAV_SPEED_DN is used

param.name: ArduCopter:PILOT_SPEED_UP
param.documentation: The maximum vertical ascending velocity the pilot may request in cm/s

param.name: ArduCopter:PILOT_ACCEL_Z
param.documentation: The vertical acceleration used when pilot is controlling the altitude

param.name: ArduCopter:FLTMODE1
param.documentation: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is <= 1230

param.name: ArduCopter:FLTMODE2
param.documentation: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1230, <= 1360

param.name: ArduCopter:FLTMODE3
param.documentation: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1360, <= 1490

param.name: ArduCopter:FLTMODE4
param.documentation: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1490, <= 1620

param.name: ArduCopter:FLTMODE5
param.documentation: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1620, <= 1749

param.name: ArduCopter:FLTMODE6
param.documentation: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >=1750

param.name: ArduCopter:FLTMODE_CH
param.documentation: RC Channel to use for flight mode control

param.name: ArduCopter:LOG_BITMASK
param.documentation: Bitmap of what on-board log types to enable. This value is made up of the sum of each of the log types you want to be saved. It is usually best just to enable all basiclog types by setting this to 65535.
param.field: 0:Fast Attitude,1:Medium Attitude,2:GPS,3:System Performance,4:Control Tuning,5:Navigation Tuning,6:RC input,7:IMU,8:Mission Commands,9:Battery Monitor,10:RC output,11:Optical Flow,12:PID,13:Compass,15:Camera,17:Motors,18:Fast IMU,19:Raw IMU,20:Video Stabilization,21:Fast harmonic notch logging

param.name: ArduCopter:PILOT_SPEED_DN
param.documentation: The maximum vertical descending velocity the pilot may request in cm/s. If 0 PILOT_SPEED_UP value is used.

param.name: ArduCopter:LAND_ALT_LOW
param.documentation: Altitude during Landing at which vehicle slows to LAND_SPEED

param.name: ArduCopter:FS_THR_VALUE
param.documentation: The PWM level in microseconds on channel 3 below which throttle failsafe triggers

param.name: ArduCopter:FS_CRASH_CHECK
param.documentation: This enables automatic crash checking. When enabled the motors will disarm if a crash is detected.

param.name: ArduCopter:RC_SPEED
param.documentation: This is the speed in Hertz that your ESCs will receive updates

param.name: ArduCopter:FS_VIBE_ENABLE
param.documentation: This enables the vibration failsafe which will use modified altitude estimation and control during high vibrations

param.name: ArduCopter:FS_GCS_TIMEOUT
param.documentation: Timeout before triggering the GCS failsafe

param.name: ArduCopter:FS_DR_TIMEOUT
param.documentation: DeadReckoning is available for this many seconds after losing position and/or velocity source. After this timeout elapses the EKF failsafe will trigger in modes requiring a position estimate

param.name: ARSPD_DEVID
param.documentation: Airspeed sensor ID, taking into account its type, bus and instance

param.humanName: Pitch axis angle controller P gain

param.humanName: Yaw axis angle controller P gain
param.name: ATC_ANG_YAW_P

param.documentation: calibrated ground pressure in Pascals

param.documentation: calibrated ground pressure in Pascals

param.name: BARO3_DEVID

param.name: COMPASS_DEV_ID2

param.name: COMPASS_DEV_ID3

param.name: COMPASS_DEV_ID4

param.name: EK3_LOG_LEVEL
param.documentation: Determines how verbose the EKF3 streaming logging is. A value of 0 provides full logging(default), a value of 1 only XKF4 scaled innovations are logged, a value of 2 both XKF4 and GSF are logged, and a value of 3 disables all streaming logging of EKF3.

param.name: GPS_CAN_NODEID1
param.documentation: GPS Node id for first-discovered GPS.

param.name: GPS_CAN_NODEID2
param.documentation: GPS Node id for second-discovered GPS.

param.name: INS_GYRO_FILTER
param.documentation: Filter cutoff frequency for gyroscopes. This can be set to a lower value to try to cope with very high vibration levels in aircraft. A value of zero means no filtering (not recommended!)

param.name: INS_ACCEL_FILTER
param.documentation: Filter cutoff frequency for accelerometers. This can be set to a lower value to try to cope with very high vibration levels in aircraft. A value of zero means no filtering (not recommended!)

param.name: INS_GYR_ID
param.documentation: Gyro sensor ID, taking into account its type, bus and instance

param.name: INS_GYR2_ID
param.documentation: Gyro2 sensor ID, taking into account its type, bus and instance

param.name: INS_GYR3_ID
param.documentation: Gyro3 sensor ID, taking into account its type, bus and instance

param.name: INS_ACC_ID
param.documentation: Accelerometer sensor ID, taking into account its type, bus and instance

param.name: INS_ACC2_ID
param.documentation: Accelerometer2 sensor ID, taking into account its type, bus and instance

param.name: INS_ACC3_ID
param.documentation: Accelerometer3 sensor ID, taking into account its type, bus and instance

param.name: INS_LOG_BAT_CNT
param.documentation: Number of samples to take when logging streams of IMU sensor readings. Will be rounded down to a multiple of 32. This option takes effect on the next reboot.

param.name: INS_LOG_BAT_LGIN
param.documentation: Interval between pushing samples to the AP_Logger log

param.name: INS_LOG_BAT_LGCT
param.documentation: Number of samples to push to count every INS_LOG_BAT_LGIN

param.name: LOG_BACKEND_TYPE
param.documentation: Bitmap of what Logger backend types to enable. Block-based logging is available on SITL and boards with dataflash chips. Multiple backends can be selected.

param.humanName: Maximum AP_Logger File and Block Backend buffer size (in kilobytes)
param.name: LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE
param.documentation: The File and Block backends use a buffer to store data before writing to the block device. Raising this value may reduce "gaps" in your SD card logging. This buffer size may be reduced depending on available memory. PixHawk requires at least 4 kilobytes. Maximum value available here is 64 kilobytes.

param.humanName: Stop logging to current file on disarm
param.name: LOG_FILE_DSRMROT
param.documentation: When set, the current log file is closed when the vehicle is disarmed. If LOG_DISARMED is set then a fresh log will be opened. Applies to the File and Block logging backends.

param.humanName: Maximum AP_Logger MAVLink Backend buffer size
param.name: LOG_MAV_BUFSIZE
param.documentation: Maximum amount of memory to allocate to AP_Logger-over-mavlink

param.humanName: Timeout before giving up on file writes
param.name: LOG_FILE_TIMEOUT
param.documentation: This controls the amount of time before failing writes to a log file cause the file to be closed and logging stopped.

param.humanName: Old logs on the SD card will be deleted to maintain this amount of free space
param.name: LOG_FILE_MB_FREE
param.documentation: Set this such that the free space is larger than your largest typical flight log

param.humanName: Maximum logging rate for file backend
param.name: LOG_FILE_RATEMAX
param.documentation: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to the file backend. A value of zero means that rate limiting is disabled.

param.humanName: Maximum logging rate for mavlink backend
param.name: LOG_MAV_RATEMAX
param.documentation: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to the mavlink backend. A value of zero means that rate limiting is disabled.

param.name: LOIT_ANG_MAX
param.documentation: Loiter maximum pilot requested lean angle. Set to zero for 2/3 of PSC_ANGLE_MAX/ANGLE_MAX. The maximum vehicle lean angle is still limited by PSC_ANGLE_MAX/ANGLE_MAX

param.name: LOIT_SPEED
param.documentation: Defines the maximum speed in cm/s which the aircraft will travel horizontally while in loiter mode

param.name: LOIT_ACC_MAX
param.documentation: Loiter maximum correction acceleration in cm/s/s. Higher values cause the copter to correct position errors more aggressively.

param.name: LOIT_BRK_ACCEL
param.documentation: Loiter braking acceleration in cm/s/s. Higher values stop the copter more quickly when the stick is centered.

param.name: LOIT_BRK_JERK
param.documentation: Loiter braking jerk in cm/s/s/s. Higher values will remove braking faster if the pilot moves the sticks during a braking maneuver.

param.name: LOIT_BRK_DELAY
param.documentation: Loiter brake start delay (in seconds)

param.name: MIS_TOTAL
param.documentation: The number of mission mission items that has been loaded by the ground station. Do not change this manually.

param.name: NTF_DISPLAY_TYPE
param.documentation: This sets up the type of on-board I2C display. Disabled by default.

param.name: OSD_FONT
param.documentation: This sets which OSD font to use. It is an integer from 0 to the number of fonts available

param.name: OSD_V_OFFSET

param.name: OSD_H_OFFSET
param.documentation: Sets horizontal offset of the osd inside image

param.documentation: Set level at which NSAT item will flash

param.name: OSD_UNITS

param.name: OSD_MSG_TIME
param.documentation: Sets message duration seconds

param.name: OSD_W_AVGCELLV
param.documentation: Set level at which AVGCELLV item will flash

param.name: OSD_CELL_COUNT
param.documentation: Used for average cell voltage display. -1 disables, 0 uses cell count autodetection for well charged LIPO/LIION batteries at connection, other values manually select cell count used.

param.name: OSD_W_RESTVOLT
param.documentation: Set level at which RESTVOLT item will flash

param.name: OSD_CHAN
param.documentation: This sets the channel used to switch different OSD screens.

param.documentation: This sets the method used to switch different OSD screens.

values.value: switch to next screen if channel value was changed
select screen based on pwm ranges specified for each screen
switch to next screen after low to high transition and every 1s while channel value is high

param.documentation: Total time autopilot has run

param.name: TCAL_TEMP_MIN
param.documentation: Minimum learned temperature. This is automatically set by the learning process

param.name: TCAL_TEMP_MAX
param.documentation: Maximum learned temperature. This is automatically set by the learning process

param.name: TCAL_BARO_EXP
param.documentation: Learned exponent for barometer temperature correction

param.name: WPNAV_SPEED
param.documentation: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain horizontally during a WP mission

param.name: WPNAV_RADIUS
param.documentation: Defines the distance from a waypoint, that when crossed indicates the wp has been hit.

param.name: WPNAV_SPEED_UP
param.documentation: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while climbing during a WP mission

param.name: WPNAV_SPEED_DN
param.documentation: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while descending during a WP mission

param.name: WPNAV_ACCEL
param.documentation: Defines the horizontal acceleration in cm/s/s used during missions

param.name: WPNAV_ACCEL_Z
param.documentation: Defines the vertical acceleration in cm/s/s used during missions

param.name: ARMING_ACCTHRESH
param.documentation: Accelerometer error threshold used to determine inconsistent accelerometers. Compares this error range to other accelerometers to detect a hardware or calibration error. Lower value means tighter check and harder to pass arming check. Not all accelerometers are created equal.

param.name: BATT_CAPACITY
param.documentation: Capacity of the battery in mAh when full

param.name: BATT_SERIAL_NUM
param.documentation: Battery serial number, automatically filled in for SMBus batteries, otherwise will be -1. With DroneCan it is the battery_id.

param.name: BATT_LOW_TIMER
param.documentation: This is the timeout in seconds before a low voltage event will be triggered. For aircraft with low C batteries it may be necessary to raise this in order to cope with low voltage on long takeoffs. A value of zero disables low voltage errors.

param.name: BATT_FS_VOLTSRC
param.documentation: Voltage type used for detection of low voltage event

param.name: BATT_LOW_VOLT
param.documentation: Battery voltage that triggers a low battery failsafe. Set to 0 to disable. If the battery voltage drops below this voltage continuously for more then the period specified by the BATT_LOW_TIMER parameter then the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT_FS_LOW_ACT parameter.

param.name: BATT_LOW_MAH
param.documentation: Battery capacity at which the low battery failsafe is triggered. Set to 0 to disable battery remaining failsafe. If the battery capacity drops below this level the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT_FS_LOW_ACT parameter.

param.name: BATT_CRT_VOLT
param.documentation: Battery voltage that triggers a critical battery failsafe. Set to 0 to disable. If the battery voltage drops below this voltage continuously for more then the period specified by the BATT_LOW_TIMER parameter then the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT_FS_CRT_ACT parameter.

param.name: BATT_ARM_VOLT
param.documentation: Battery voltage level which is required to arm the aircraft. Set to 0 to allow arming at any voltage.

param.name: RC_OVERRIDE_TIME
param.documentation: Timeout after which RC overrides will no longer be used, and RC input will resume, 0 will disable RC overrides, -1 will never timeout, and continue using overrides until they are disabled
